name: Winyah Blueberry Farm Blue Truck Organics
tagline: Blue Truck Organics: Cultivating Crops and Community
description: Winyah Blueberry Farm Blue Truck Organics is a family-run berry farm in Georgetown, SC. It grows Blueberries, Flowers, and Eggs, with picking through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
